jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
## **Who we want**

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Associate Software Engineer, you’ll be embedded in our Engineering organization.

Garner’s Engineering team tackles incredibly hard technical problems for a mission that truly matters. Our systems analyze billions of medical records to rank healthcare providers across the country. We expect our engineers to champion cutting-edge industry practices as we aggressively embrace AI in every facet of our operations and norms. We are seeking teammates who take pride in doing great work and stay curious about new techniques and technologies.

## **What you will do**

- Use AI to build, optimize, and maintain software systems
- Collaborate across disciplines to understand our users and iterate on new ideas
- Protect our users’ privacy and security through secure coding practices
- Participate in code reviews, sharing your insights and learning from others

## **What we're looking for**

- Recent graduate (Spring 2026) or currently enrolled student (expected graduation of Fall 2026 or Spring 2027), with a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related STEM field
- Solid CS fundamentals with experience in front-end (JavaScript, React) or back-end (Python, Node.js) technologies
- Experience with a database system such as PostgreSQL or ElasticSearch; familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Docker) is a plus
- Exposure to building with AI coding agents (we use Claude Code) is a plus
- A track record of shipping high-quality features through internships or personal projects
- Strong technical writing, analytical, and communication skills
- Excited to join a high-performing, mission-driven team that values urgency, accountability, and honest feedback
- A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics

## **What you’ll get here**

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose. 

## **Technologies we use**

- Claude Code, Kubernetes, AWS, Airflow, dlt, dbt, Python, TypeScript, React, Go

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

## **Compensation**

The target base comp range for this role is $150,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

*Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.*

**Jr. AI Engineer Role** 




 An AI \+ Engineering role. Build models and AI systems (document processing, truck tracking, and more), plus full\-stack software for USA and Australia clients. Freshers to 2 years. Hyderabad / Hybrid. ₹4–6 LPA.
 



  





 You will work on both sides: applied AI (building and shipping models for document processing, truck tracking, and similar problems, plus LLM integrations where they fit) and full\-stack engineering (frontend, backend, APIs, and shipping to production). You will support real clients in the USA and Australia. Your work ships. It is not a sandbox or a training exercise.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 aiqon is hiring for the Jr. AI Engineer Role. This is an AI \+ Engineering role, not a teaching or research\-only position. You will build AI systems and ship full\-stack product work for industry clients in the USA and Australia.
 



  





 The work is broader than LLM integrations. Depending on the client, you may develop or fine\-tune models for document processing, truck tracking and logistics, computer vision, or similar applied problems, then take those models into production.
 



  





 On a typical week, you might train or adapt a document\-extraction model, work on a tracking pipeline, integrate an LLM into a workflow, then jump to a React or API change or a production bug. We need people who can work across applied AI and software engineering, not just one or the other.
 



 This role is based in Hyderabad (hybrid). You will support USA and Australia clients, so overlapping hours with those time zones are required.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Develop, adapt, and ship models for applied problems such as document processing, truck tracking and logistics, and similar client use cases, not only LLM integrations.
* Build and ship AI features such as retrieval pipelines, model serving, and tooling that makes those systems reliable in production.
* Contribute to full\-stack engineering: product UI, APIs, data, and the glue that holds client systems together.
* Support USA and Australia client projects with clear communication and overlapping hours.
* Write clear, maintainable code with tests; participate in code review and iterate based on feedback.
* Debug issues end\-to\-end, from model output to UI to API to data, and document what you learn so the team can move faster.
* Collaborate with product and client stakeholders to turn operational needs into working software.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* Minimum eligibility: freshers coming out of college, through to candidates with up to 2 years of professional experience.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Compensation: ₹4–6 lakhs per annum.
* This is an AI \+ Engineering role: you should be ready to develop applied models (document processing, tracking, and similar problems), work with LLMs when needed, and ship full\-stack software.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript; you can write working software without being walked through every step.
* Comfort with Git, web fundamentals (HTTP, REST, HTML/CSS), and at least one modern full\-stack stack (e.g. React, Node, or a Python web stack).
* Genuine interest in AI/ML. You experiment, read docs, and ship small projects of your own.
* A GitHub, portfolio, or LinkedIn that shows work you have actually built.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; you can explain trade\-offs and ask for help early.
* Willing to work overlapping hours with USA and Australia time zones to support those clients.
* Based in, or willing to work from, Hyderabad in hybrid mode.



  





*Due to high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Thank you.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Software Engineer \- Full Stack
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Payments Network Technology is seeking a software engineer to design, build, and support secure, scalable, and highly available payment\-network solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, event\-driven architecture, and cloud\-native engineering practices.
   

  

 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support software services based on technical and functional requirements.
* Build Java and Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Kafka\-based event\-driven integrations.
* Develop responsive user experiences and integrate front\-end applications with secure backend APIs.
* Apply object\-oriented design, SOLID principles, reusable patterns, and secure coding practices.
* Create unit, component, integration, and regression tests and participate in peer reviews.
* Troubleshoot application, data, messaging, performance, and production issues.
* Contribute to CI/CD, observability, operational readiness, resiliency, and automation.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, testing, operations, and dependent engineering teams.


**Essential Skills**
* Hands\-on Java and Spring Boot development experience.
* Experience with microservices, REST APIs, Kafka or similar messaging platforms, and event\-driven architecture.
* Hands\-on Angular development experience is required, including TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Micro Front End architecture, and UX implementation.
* Experience converting Figma designs into responsive, reusable, and accessible Angular components and user interfaces.
* Knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Understanding of secure, scalable, resilient, and observable software design.


**All About You**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot and Claude CLI, to improve engineering efficiency is required.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design, code, test, and deploy end\-to\-end full\-stack applications in a high\-performing, scalable enterprise environment
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using modern front\-end technologies including HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, jQuery, and Node.js
* Build scalable back\-end microservices and web services using Java, Spring Boot, and enterprise application servers (Red Hat JBoss EAP, Tomcat)
* Design, optimize, and maintain relational database queries and schemas utilizing SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL
* Implement automated test suites using Mockito, JUnit, and Selenium to maintain continuous integration and software quality standards
* Build, maintain, and enhance DevOps CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments using Jenkins, Azure, Docker, and GitHub
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and engineering practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), collaborating with cross\-functional product and engineering teams to deliver iterative software solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of full\-stack software development experience in high\-performing, scalable application environments
* 2\+ years of experience with front\-end technologies including HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, and Node.js
* 2\+ years of experience building microservices and web services with Spring Boot and application servers such as Tomcat or Red Hat JBoss EAP
* 2\+ years of experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL)
* 1\+ years of experience with automated testing tools and frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, or Selenium)
* 1\+ years of experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git/GitHub, Docker, and Microsoft Azure
* Experience working within an Agile development methodology (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Hands\-on experience deploying, managing, and optimizing microservices in Microsoft Azure cloud environments
* Experience with jQuery and modern front\-end state management libraries
* Demonstrated solid technical troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and code optimization skills in high\-concurrency environments


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

 We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer (Next.js \+ tRPC) to work closely with the founding team in building and scaling a modern, high\-performance web platform. You'll play a key role in shaping both the product and engineering decisions, collaborating across product, engineering, and marketing to deliver a seamless user experience. This is a role for someone who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment, taking ownership, and contributing across the stack, from frontend UX to backend APIs and integrations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain scalable web applications using Next.js (App Router) and React 18

* Implement responsive and accessible UI using Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, Radix UI, and modern component patterns
* Manage server state and data fetching using TanStack React Query
* Contribute to analytics, logging, and monitoring using tools like PostHog and Axiom
* Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and performance optimizations
* Work within a monorepo setup (pnpm \+ Turborepo) for efficient development and scaling



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Proficiency in TypeScript
* Hands\-on experience with Next.js and React
* Experience building APIs using tRPC or similar frameworks

* Strong knowledge of REST/HTTP concepts, API design, and data fetching strategies

* Experience with modern styling approaches like Tailwind CSS
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to take ownership of features from concept to production



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

* Familiarity with authentication systems like Clerk

**What Success Looks Like** 



* Owning and shipping features end\-to\-end with minimal hand\-holding
* Writing clean, scalable, and well\-documented code that the team can build on
* Proactively identifying performance bottlenecks and resolving them before they become problems
* Contributing meaningfully to architectural and product decisions alongside the founding team



  





**What's in It for You** 



* Work directly with the founding team, fast learning and real ownership from Day 1
* Shape the product and engineering culture at an early\-stage, fast\-growing startup
* Work on a modern, cutting\-edge tech stack across the full product lifecycle

#  Node.js Developer job description
A Node.js developer is in charge of composing server-side web application logic in JavaScript and/or JavaScript variants such as CoffeeScript, IcedCoffeeScript, and so on. Back-end components are typically developed by Node.js developers, who connect the application to other (often third-party) web services and assist front-end developers by embedding their work with the Node.js application.

## Node.js Developer Job Brief
We are looking for a Node.js Developer to manage data exchange between the server and client applications. Your primary responsibility will be to develop all server-side logic, define and maintain the central database, and ensure high performance and responsiveness to front-end requests. You will also be in charge of incorporating the front-end elements created by your coworkers into the application. As a result, a basic understanding of front-end technologies such as Vue.js, Angular JS, React JS, or any Javascript Framework is required.
### Node.js Developer Responsibilities
  * Low latency, high availability, and performant application design and implementation.
  * Understanding of the entire web stack, including protocols and web server optimization techniques.
  * Security and data protection integration.
  * Knowledge of web frameworks and libraries such as AngularJS, Polymer, and Closure is required.
  * Assure that the code is highly robust and capable of providing high performance to the end user.
  * Connect server-side code to front-end components.
  * Develop a user interface for the customer and back-end services for payment processing administration and management.
  * Use tools and ingenuity to detect and correct flaws before they become a problem.
  * Create adequate test suites to ensure that all features outlined in the design are met.
  * Make sure that modern security standards are in place to prevent unauthorized entry.


### Node.js Developer Requirements
  * Understanding the characteristics of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds.
  * Excellent command of server-side templating languages.
  * Fundamental knowledge of front-end technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap.
  * Ability to combine multiple data sources and databases into a single system.
  * Understanding of the entire web stack, including protocols and web server optimization techniques.
  * Understanding of the Node.js Framework.
  * Knowledgeable of code versioning tools such as Git or TFS.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (Python + React)
jobs.description:
Monefy is a business and technology services company based in Brașov, Romania. We run
back-office operations for healthcare practices in the US, and we build the software those
practices use for their day-to-day work. We're the operator as well as the vendor, so we
end up using most of what we build.

We look for people who ask a lot of questions, finish what they take on, and want to keep
getting better at the job.

## About the product

You'll be working on our healthcare platform: an EHR (electronic health record) and medical
billing system used by clinics in the US. It covers patient records, scheduling, intake, a
patient portal, insurance claims and payment posting.

The data is medical and the numbers end up on real invoices, so we're careful about
correctness and about who gets to see what.

## The role

You'll own features from start to finish: backend, frontend, database migrations and tests.
Usually you'll pick up something a clinic has asked for and stay with it until it's live,
and we'll expect you to be able to explain the choices you made along the way.

You'll report to the CTO and work with him closely, which means plenty of mentoring and
plenty of scrutiny on your work.

### What you'll do

- Build features across the stack: Django/DRF APIs, React + TypeScript interfaces, schema
  changes and tests.
- Write a short design plan before you start coding, and talk it through with us.
- Check your own work before anyone else sees it: run it, try to break it, fix what you find.
- Walk a reviewer through your code, line by line if they ask.
- Find your way around a large codebase you didn't write, and leave it a bit tidier than
  you found it.
- Learn the domain: how clinics schedule, what an insurance claim is, how a payment gets
  posted.

## What we're looking for

- At least a year of professional Python web development. If you don't have that on paper
  but you have your own complex projects you can talk us through in detail, apply anyway.
- Python with Django (Flask or FastAPI counts) and REST API design.
- React with TypeScript, and the SPA basics: state, routing, async, talking to an API.
- SQL and an ORM. You can read a schema, write a query with a few joins in it, and work out
  what a migration will do to data that's already there.
- Comfortable with Git and with a Unix-based OS.
- You write tests, and you also open the application and check that it behaves the way it
  should.
- You can read code you didn't write, say what it does and spot where it's likely to break.
- You can explain every line of code you submit, including anything you generated.
- Clear written and spoken English. You'll be writing short design documents most weeks and
  discussing them daily.
- Based in Romania and available Monday–Friday, 12:00–21:00 EEST.

## Nice to have

- Django REST Framework, Celery, OpenAPI-generated clients.
- Testing tooling: pytest, vitest/jest, Playwright.
- AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, ElastiCache).
- You've worked on a team with real code review, where your pull requests came back with
  changes requested.
- Any exposure to healthcare, insurance or billing systems.
- Patience for an unglamorous domain. Healthcare admin is full of small rules and edge
  cases, and it rewards people who find that sort of thing interesting.

## Who you are

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Logical thinker with strong analytical skills
- Displays a high level of initiative and resourcefulness
- Seeks out opportunities for creative expression and exploration
- Prefers an agile work environment over traditional structures

## What we offer

- **€2,000–3,000 gross / month**, depending on what you can demonstrate.
- **Real ownership**: whole features across frontend, backend, migrations and tests.
- **A learning budget** for courses, books and conferences.
- Private medical insurance, which kicks in once you're past your first three months.
- Team-building activities, and a company that means it about work-life balance.
- An early-stage product, so what you build reaches clinics quick

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
## Job Description: Software Engineer (SWE)
----

### About SWARA

At **SWARA**, we are revolutionizing the job search experience. We build AI-powered tools that scan thousands of jobs across every board, score them against candidates' resumes using an advanced AI matching engine, and surface the absolute best opportunities. In addition, we help users build ATS-optimized resumes and provide real-time ATS scoring-all for free. We are a fast-moving, early-stage startup looking to completely change the way people find and land their dream jobs.

---

### The Role

As a Software Engineer at SWARA, you will be a core contributor to our AI matching engine and full-stack platform. You will work directly with the founders in a highly collaborative environment to build and scale the infrastructure that powers our job aggregation, resume parsing, and recommendation algorithms. This is an incredible opportunity to make a massive impact at a growing early-stage startup.

---

### Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain scalable back-end services that power our job aggregation and ATS scoring engines.
* Develop intuitive, responsive, and high-performance front-end features for our core web platform.
* Integrate and optimize Large Language Models (LLMs) and vector databases to improve our AI resume matching accuracy.
* Build robust data pipelines to securely ingest, parse, and process thousands of job postings and user resumes on a daily basis.
* Collaborate with the founding team to brainstorm, prototype, and ship new product features rapidly.
* Write clean, well-documented, and highly testable code while maintaining engineering best practices.

---

### Qualifications & Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience or projects in full-stack software development.
* Strong proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks like React, Next.js.
* Experience designing, building, and interacting with RESTful APIs and relational/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

---

### Nice to Have

* Previous experience working with OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or general machine learning infrastructure.
* Background in building reliable web scrapers or large-scale data ingestion tools.
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and resume parsing algorithms.

---

### What We Offer

* Competitive salary with early-stage equity options.
* Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.
* Direct mentorship and hands-on experience shaping a product from the ground up.

**Job Description**




**Role: Java Fullstack Developer** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




**Shift time: 1 PM to 10 PM** 




**Work mode: Hybrid** 




  





**Job Overview:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack Developer who can design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end web applications. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in Java\-based back\-end services, modern JavaScript frameworks on the front end, and is comfortable working in an Agile, DevOps\-driven environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end web applications using Java and front\-end frameworks.
* Develop RESTful APIs / microservices using Java, Spring / Spring Boot.
* Build responsive, user\-friendly UIs using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and frameworks such as Angular / React / Vue (as per project stack).
* Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA, and DevOps to deliver high\-quality features on time.
* Write clean, modular, testable code following coding standards and best practices.
* Integrate applications with databases (RDBMS/NoSQL) and external systems.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Implement unit tests, integration tests, and support automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and defects.
* Contribute to technical documentation (design documents, API specs, deployment guides).



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Backend:** 



* Strong experience with Java (8 or above)
* Hands\-on with Spring / Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security
* Experience in building RESTful APIs / microservices



**Frontend:** 



* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
* Experience with at least one modern JavaScript framework: Angular / React / Vue
* Familiarity with responsive design and cross\-browser compatibility



**Database:** 



* Experience with RDBMS (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
* Good understanding of SQL, query optimization, and data modeling
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus



**Tools \& Processes:** 



* Experience with Git or similar version control systems
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, etc.)
* Working experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies



**Other:** 



* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Good understanding of design patterns, OOP, and software engineering principles
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

* Agile development practices and workflows


**Security Protocols:**
* Understanding of web security principles and best practices


**Experience Requirements**

* Experience working on cross\-functional teams involving designers, product managers, and backend developers
* Prior exposure to testing frameworks such as Jest or Mocha


**Alternative pathways:**

**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Develop, test, and maintain front\-end features using React.js, ensuring responsiveness across devices
* Implement server\-side functionalities with Node.js, integrating with RESTful APIs or GraphQL endpoints
* Participate in daily stand\-ups, planning sessions, and project reviews
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to realize user\-centered designs
* Conduct code reviews for peers, ensuring adherence to coding standards
* Troubleshoot application issues, perform bug fixes, and optimize performance
* Contribute to documentation of technical specifications and development practices
* Continuously learn and recommend emerging web technologies and frameworks


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
* Additional certifications in React, Node.js, or related web technologies are a plus
* Proven track record of delivering scalable and maintainable web applications
* Experience with full development lifecycle, from design through deployment and maintenance


**Professional Competencies**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking abilities
* Excellent communication skills for effective stakeholder and team collaboration
* Ability to work efficiently both independently and within a team
* Adaptability to fast\-paced project requirements and changing priorities
* Willingness to learn new technologies and enhance skills continuously
* Strong organizational skills for managing multiple tasks and meeting deadlines

jobs.title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, India
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**About The Role**
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.
   

  

**Why you’ll love this role**
* Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow\-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
* Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
* Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
* Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote\-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self\-direction are the pillars of success.
* User\-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.


**What You’ll Do**
* Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
* Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
* Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on\-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
* Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
* Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
* Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow\-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
* Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
* Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
* AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.


**Helpful Experience**
* Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
* Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
* PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event\-driven workflows.
* Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
* Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.


**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

**About Nexora Group**
Nexora Group is a forward-thinking technology and innovation company focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and emerging technologies to solve real-world business challenges. We provide opportunities for aspiring professionals to gain hands-on experience, work on impactful projects, and develop industry-relevant skills in a collaborative environment.
  

**Internship Overview**
We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated **Data Science with AI Interns** to join our growing team. This internship is designed for students and recent graduates who are passionate about data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision-making.
  

The selected candidates will work alongside experienced professionals on real-world datasets, AI models, and business intelligence projects while gaining practical exposure to industry-standard tools and technologies.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
  * Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets.
  * Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and generate actionable insights.
  * Assist in developing and deploying machine learning and AI models.
  * Work with Python, SQL, and data visualization tools.
  * Create dashboards, reports, and data-driven presentations.
  * Support predictive analytics and model evaluation activities.
  * Collaborate with cross-functional teams on AI-driven projects.
  * Research emerging trends in Data Science, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
  * Document project findings and maintain technical reports.


  

**Required Skills**

jobs.description:
**Title: Ai/ML Engineer** 




**Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore** 




  





**About the role** 




 You'll build the AI and machine learning systems that power Matilda Cloud's intelligent cloud cost optimization, policy management, and recommendation engine. This means shipping production agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, fine\-tuned models, and ML services — all running across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI at enterprise scale.
 



**What you'll work on** 



* Migrate cloud pricing and policy APIs to agentic AI architectures using LangGraph and MCP
* Build RAG pipelines for AI\-generated cost allocation and capacity reports
* Design and execute the distillation pipeline: teacher data capture (Claude/Bedrock) → SFT/DPO training → Qwen student model
* Build the cloud cost forecasting engine and anomaly detection service (Prometheus \+ time\-series ML)
* Instrument LLMOps observability: tracing, cost monitoring, groundedness evals (LangSmith)
* Expose Matilda's cloud discovery data as MCP tool surfaces for agentic consumption



**Must have** 



* 4\+ years of software engineering with Python as primary language
* Hands\-on with LLM APIs — AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or Anthropic — including function calling and structured outputs
* Built at least one production RAG pipeline (chunking, vector DB, hybrid retrieval)
* LangChain or LangGraph experience — agent loops, tool use, state management
* Strong cloud experience on at least two of: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI — specifically AI/ML services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI)
* Kubernetes for deploying and scaling ML services
* Experience with ML data pipelines — feature engineering, ETL for training data
* Time\-series analysis or anomaly detection in a production setting



**Nice to have** 



* MCP (Model Context Protocol) — building or consuming MCP servers
* LLM fine\-tuning: SFT dataset construction, DPO, or LoRA/QLoRA
* Model distillation — teacher/student patterns
* LangSmith or equivalent LLMOps observability platform
* FinOps / cloud cost domain knowledge (a big plus given our product)
* Experience with LiteLLM, model routers, or multi\-provider LLM setups

**Role:** 
 Frontend Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Engineering / Frontend Development
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore (Onsite)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 E\-learning, Education Management, SaaS
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is a cloud\-based tutor management platform built for tutoring businesses, online educators, and test prep providers. It automates scheduling, payments, attendance tracking, invoice generation, and course delivery.
 



 The platform supports both 1\-on\-1 and group learning models. It serves over 2,000 businesses, with notable clients including Bambinos, Network Kings, Sarva, and LSL.
 



 The team is 35 people strong, fast\-moving, and mission\-driven. Engineers take real ownership and see the direct impact of their work.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 As a Frontend Engineer, you will build and own production\-ready features that power the core product experience for thousands of tutoring businesses. You'll work directly with product and design to translate requirements into clean, performant UI, and take full accountability from development through post\-launch. This is a high\-ownership role in a lean team where your work ships fast and matters immediately.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain production\-ready frontend features using React and modern JavaScript across the platform
* Translate product requirements into clean, functional, and responsive UI components with minimal back\-and\-forth
* Integrate frontend with REST APIs and handle async data flows reliably across scheduling, payments, and reporting surfaces
* Debug and resolve UI issues to root cause — not surface\-level patches — across browsers and devices
* Take full ownership of features from development through release and post\-launch monitoring
* Continuously improve performance, accessibility, and code quality across the codebase
* Adapt to shifting product priorities without introducing regressions or accruing technical debt



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on production experience building with React
* Strong JavaScript fundamentals — closures, async/await, event loop, ES6\+
* Solid command of React hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext, custom hooks) and component architecture
* Proven experience integrating with REST APIs and managing async data in frontend applications
* Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive layout techniques
* Experience working in a B2B SaaS product environment
* Available to work onsite full\-time from Bangalore



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building SaaS dashboards or admin panels with complex data tables and filters
* Hands\-on frontend performance optimization — lazy loading, code splitting, memoization
* Familiarity with modern frontend tooling such as Vite, Webpack, or ESLint
* Exposure to state management libraries such as Redux Toolkit or Zustand
* Prior experience at a startup or early\-stage SaaS company



  





**What We Offer** 



* High\-ownership role in a 35\-person team — your work ships to 2,000\+ real businesses immediately
* Onsite role in Bangalore with a fast\-moving, mission\-driven team
* Direct exposure to product, design, and business decisions at an early company stage
* Opportunity to shape frontend architecture and engineering culture as the team scales

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Product
jobs.description:
**AI at Brex**

AI Engineering at Brex is redefining how businesses run their finances by building intelligent, autonomous systems directly into the Brex platform. Our teams develop AI agents that don’t just surface insights—they take action, optimizing spend, managing workflows, and making real-time decisions on behalf of our customers. By deeply integrating proprietary financial data with product and platform infrastructure, we’re turning complex financial operations into simple, automated experiences and setting a new standard for how modern finance works.

**What you’ll do**

You'll be a product engineer building Brex's Audit Agent — an agentic system that reviews customer spend at scale and replaces the manual work traditionally done by BPO teams. The agent itself reasons; the surrounding product harness is what makes that reasoning useful, trustworthy, and operable for real customers.

That product harness is where you'll live. You'll design and ship the workflows, surfaces, and data flows that turn the agent's output into something a reviewer can trust and act on — from the reviewer experience itself, to the contracts with Brex's financial system of record, to the feedback loops that make the agent better over time. You'll move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands, picking the right altitude for the problem rather than defending a layer.

This role sits between deep agent design and the customer-facing UI, and it leans toward whichever side the next user problem lives on. You'll partner closely with the engineers driving each — translating ambiguous product requirements into shipped features, pushing back when the design isn't right, and treating the seam between agent reasoning and human workflow as a first-class product surface.

The majority of your work will be backend: system design, data modeling, API shape. A meaningful minority will be on the UI itself, where you'll build alongside our frontend engineers when that's where the next user problem lives.

**Where you’ll work**

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three coordinated days in the office per week — Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

**Responsibilities**

- Build and ship customer-facing features in production — from sketch to rollout to iteration based on real customer feedback.
- Define the data contracts between the agent and the rest of Brex's financial system of record, and evolve them as the product gets sharper.
- Stand up feedback and evaluation loops that let us quickly gather product signals and close them with product fixes — better signals, better surfaces, better workflows.
- Run experiments on customer-facing behavior (UI flows, prompt-driven product changes, new review modes) and make calls based on what the data says.
- Talk to customers and reviewers directly, bring what you learn back into the product, and prioritize what to build next on the team.

**Requirements**

- Strong track record of shipping customer-facing features end-to-end across both backend and frontend — you don't bounce work over a wall, and you've built enough of each to have real opinions.
- Product mindset: you reason about users, workflows, and outcomes first, and treat the system as the means to an end. Comfort with ambiguity and willingness to talk to customers directly.
- Strong bias towards action — you've operated in environments where the next thing to build wasn't handed to you in a ticket, and you've shipped things that didn't exist before.
- Comfort working across team boundaries and pushing back on decisions outside your direct ownership when the seam isn't right — agent design, UX, data model, all fair game.
- Strong backend foundation — system design, data modeling, API shape — and the disposition to ship the UI yourself when that's what the user problem needs, rather than handing it off

**Bonus points**

- Early-stage startup experience, or time on a small team where you owned a product surface end-to-end.
- Experience building products on top of LLMs or agentic systems — particularly the surrounding harness (evaluation, tracing, feedback loops, human-in-the-loop workflows).
- Background in fintech, compliance, audit, fraud, or other domains where review workflows and traceability matter.
- Experience operating where the underlying system is non-deterministic and the product has to compensate for that.
- Track record of being the engineer teams pull in when a project is stuck across backend, frontend, and a third system that nobody fully owns.

**Compensation**

The expected salary range for this role is $171,000 - $240,000 USD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Ecosystem
jobs.description:
**AI at Brex**

AI Engineering at Brex is redefining how businesses run their finances by building intelligent, autonomous systems directly into the Brex platform. Our teams develop AI agents that don’t just surface insights—they take action, optimizing spend, managing workflows, and making real-time decisions on behalf of our customers. By deeply integrating proprietary financial data with product and platform infrastructure, we’re turning complex financial operations into simple, automated experiences and setting a new standard for how modern finance works.

**What you’ll do**

You’ll be a technical owner for Brex’s external AI ecosystem: the integrations, surfaces, and standards that allow customers to interact with Brex through third-party assistants and platforms.

Over the next year, you’ll turn early integrations into first-class, exemplar applications — stable, secure, and opinionated — that are showcased by platform partners and relied on by power users at Brex’s most sophisticated customers. You’ll design how Brex data and actions are safely exposed, how permissions and auditability work across boundaries, and how new capabilities (including richer UI surfaces) are introduced over time.

This is a product role disguised as infrastructure. Success is measured by real usage, trust, and customer reliance — not by the number of integrations shipped.

**Where you’ll work**

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three coordinated days in the office per week — Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

**Responsibilities**

- Own Brex's MCP Apps for OpenAI, Claude, Slack, and other embedders, including roadmap decisions across core and long-tail partners.
- Define the technical, UX, and reliability standards for how Brex surfaces and operates within external AI assistant ecosystems.
- Design and maintain secure, auditable integration patterns, including permissions, read/write access, and acting on behalf of users across third-party environments.
- Build and operate production-grade integrations that remain resilient amid evolving platforms, unpredictable clients, and shifting constraints.
- Partner cross-functionally with Security, Platform, Sales, Enablement, and internal agent teams to ensure integrations are safe, valuable, and well-supported.
- Serve as the center of excellence for reusable AI capabilities across Brex, defining and evangelizing standards, patterns, and shared components that power AI functionality both within the Brex platform and across external ecosystem integrations.

**Requirements**

- Experience building and owning production software, including systems that integrate with or depend on third-party platforms.
- Demonstrated technical ownership for user-facing products with real external customers.
- Deep experience with identity, authentication, and secure data access across system boundaries, including OAuth and role-based access control (RBAC) for permissions.
- Proven ability to ship and operate reliable integrations with external APIs and clients outside your control.
- Strong product judgment, written communication, and end-to-end ownership, including accountability for quality and launch readiness.

**Bonus points**

- Experience publishing and maintaining apps or integrations in third-party marketplaces (iOS, Slack, Shopify, GitHub, Chrome, etc.).
- Prior work on administrative or platform-side tooling for ecosystems.
- Familiarity with conversational or agentic interfaces in production environments.
- Experience building evaluations to measure and improve the quality, reliability, and safety of AI-powered features.

**Compensation**

The expected salary range for this role is $171,000 - $240,000 USD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Dealflow (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Info:

Als AI-Engineer - Dealflow entwickelst und verantwortest du das Produkt bzw. Tool, mit dem wir unseren proprietären Dealflow im Investmentteam im DACH-Software- und Tech-Mittelstand aufbauen. Dein Ziel: Attraktive Unternehmen und ihre Gesellschafter frühzeitig identifizieren und erreichen, idealerweise bevor ein M&A-Berater mandatiert oder ein breiter Verkaufsprozess gestartet wird. 
 
Dabei verbindest du zwei Welten: AI-Skills und Deal Origination. Du baust die Daten-, Tool- und Reporting-Infrastruktur, auf der Market Maps, Outbound-Kampagnen und potenzielle Investments und ein skalierbarer Sourcing-Prozess aufsetzen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem FLEX Leadership Team, dem Investment Team und dem Data & AI Team zusammen und du erhältst vom ersten Tag an viel Ownership für den Aufbau einer zentralen Funktion bei FLEX.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust und verantwortest das AI-Produkt/Tool, das unseren Origination-Funnel kontinuierlich mit Software- und Technologieunternehmen im DACH-Mittelstand befüllt. Du entwickelst es laufend weiter und verbesserst es iterativ.
  • Du entwickelst die Screening- und Priorisierungslogik für Targets und verbesserst deren Trefferqualität systematisch.
  • Du baust die automatisierte Datenbeschaffung und -anreicherung aus, sodass Targets angereichert werden mit Firmographics und Eigentümerstrukturen.
  • Du entwickelst Logik und Workflows, um Intent-Signale und potenzielles Verkaufsinteresse zu erkennen.
  • Du initiierst die automatisierte Multichannel-Ansprache und entwickelst die zugrunde liegenden Prozesse weiter.
  • Du baust Dashboards und Reports zu Funnel, Aktivitäten und Conversion als Grundlage unserer Sourcing- und Pipeline-Reviews.
  • Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos.
  • Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit.
  • Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion. Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wo sie zuverlässig funktionieren und wo (noch) nicht.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus.
  • Du denkst kommerziell: Du verstehst, warum ein Target relevant ist und misst dich an Ergebnissen.
  • Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch.


Benefits

  • Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. 
  • Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien.   
  • Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise zweimonatliche Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro.   
  • Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsmittel, ein Office im Herzen Berlins direkt am Park am Gleisdreieck sowie eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit gesunden Snacks, Softdrinks und einem monatlichen Friday Beer/Sekt/Wein. 
  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Möglichkeiten zur Brutto-Netto-Optimierung.  


Über uns

FLEX Capital ist ein Private Equity Fonds, der sich auf Wachstums- und Buy-out-Möglichkeiten im deutschen Software- und Tech-Mittelstand fokussiert. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. Auf dieser Basis teilt das FLEX-Team seine Erfahrungen mit Unternehmern und Management Teams, unterstützt sie Hands-on und hilft ihnen so, die gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen.


Kontakt

Join us!

jobs.title: Working Student Application Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Isarsoft

We make every camera count
At ​Isarsoft ​we develop video analytics software ​to make transportation and cities more efficient, inclusive and secure. ​We stand for data protection and responsible processing of sensitive data. Being ​on the forefront of innovation we work together in interdisciplinary teams in a positive, fun and energetic atmosphere.

Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do. ​Founded in 2019 ​​we have ​grown organically winning large customers ​and partners delivering compelling, reliable, high-performance software. We are proud of being a privately held company with family atmosphere focusing on long-term relations to our customers and team members.


Your mission

  • Support Customer Success: Assist in engaging with customers to understand their technical needs and use cases for Isarsoft Perception.

  • Bridge Tech & Requirements: Work alongside our engineering team to help translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements.

  • Hands-on Technical Support: Partner with sales and engineering teams during technical workshops, product demos, and onboarding.

  • Product Improvement: Help investigate new feature opportunities based on real user data and customer feedback.


Your profile

  • Enrolled student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (ideally with at least 2 semesters remaining).

  • First practical experience (through projects, internships, or courses) in SQL, Python, and working with APIs/SDKs.

  • Strong communication skills and a problem-solving mindset with a focus on helping users.

  • Fluency in both English and German (min. C1 level required).

  • Ability to work up to 20 hours/week during the semester (flexible during semester breaks).


Additional assets

  • Familiarity with Docker or Linux environments.

  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision or AI applications.

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced tech environment

  • Modern development workflow proficiency, including the confident and reliable use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

  • Strong foundation in version control systems (Git) and hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines


Benefits

  • An experienced, highly motivated and international team to learn and grow
  • A high-impact work environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
  • Have the flexibility to work from anywhere: A great office in Munich, from home or the English-Garden
  • Free lunch, coffee and drinks at our office 
Sounds good? We are just getting started. Let's build a great company together.


Hiring Process

We are committed to a transparent and fair hiring process. We aim for concluding the interview process in no longer than 2 weeks.

The following three stages are typical for any position at Isarsoft.

  • Video Interview with HR
  • Technical Deep Dive 
We deeply believe that a great product only can be build by a great team. That's why sharing our values, being a team-player and having a energetic attitude is as important as bringing the right technical skills.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career)
jobs.description:
**The company**

Our client deploys open source infrastructure into the customer's own cloud account: Langfuse, n8n, Airflow, Dagster, ClickHouse, PostHog and self-hosted vLLM on the customer's own GPUs. One click lands the stack in their AWS, Azure or GCP with HA, backups, audit logging and SSO already on, and the client carries every upgrade, CVE and 4am page from then on. Buyers are teams forced into their own VPC by data residency or compliance, from 20 person AI companies through to regulated enterprises. Deals start with an engineer who is tired of maintaining this themselves, and grow from there.

**The role**

You make developers care, then go and talk to them.

You own the launches, the writing and the demos that reach teams self-hosting this software today, on Hacker News, Product Hunt, Reddit and X, plus the follow-through that turns a spike into retained deployments. You show up where the pain already is, in the issue trackers and Discords of the projects the client runs, answering real questions long before the product comes up.

You self-host these tools, you break them, and you write the story: upgrade postmortems, migration guides, docs-as-marketing, comparison pages, SEO and GEO, dev-influencer collabs, hackathons.

You take first calls and technical demos every week, work out what is breaking in a team's stack and what is forcing them into their own VPC, and show them exactly where this fits. You source and qualify the accounts worth talking to, keep the CRM useful, run follow-up that does not drop, and hand over warm, well-briefed deals. You own the pipeline, the founder owns the signature.

You own the instrumentation too: one funnel in PostHog and one dashboard both of you trust, so the team knows which plays worked and which ones they are telling themselves worked. That means you own the GTM tooling as well as the plays, including Clay, enrichment and the automations behind them. There is nobody else to hand that to.

Content metrics move within days. Pipeline moves over weeks and deals over quarters, and you will be judged on the full arc, not the first spike.

Nobody arrives fluent in all seven tools. You get there by breaking them.

**What the client is looking for**

* Experience marketing a developer product: you have grown an open source project, a devtool, or a data or AI-infra product, and you can point at the launches, posts, docs or pages that did it.
* Ability to run a technical sales call: comfortable demoing to engineers, asking the uncomfortable qualifying questions, and following up until you get an answer either way.
* Technical credibility, not necessarily as an engineer: you can stand the stack up yourself with Claude Code, read a stack trace, and explain what broke without a hand-holder. Production experience with this specific software is not required, and the role ships no production code. You do need to be the kind of person who would rather install a thing than read about it.
* Distribution obsession: you have built a launch, a content play or an outbound motion that converted, and you get a genuine kick out of it.
* Ownership and bias for action: you own outcomes, not tasks, and you move without waiting for a roadmap.
* Comfortable owning the GTM stack end to end: PostHog, CRM hygiene, Clay, n8n, enrichment waterfalls.

**Preferred**

* DevRel, developer-tools marketing, or GTM at a dev-tool, data-infra or AI-infra company.
* Early-stage startup experience, or having founded one.
* Activity in the self-hosting and open source infra community.
* Able to work in person in San Francisco at least three days a week.

## About the job
### About Sunset
At its core, Sunset was founded to help founders. We started by supporting startups through shutting down, but we have since expanded into unlocking a new revenue stream for all types of businesses.
In 2025, we had a unique insight: the data every company generates each day through collaboration, communication, and building is some of the most valuable training data in the world. Public and synthetic data can only get frontier models so far, so the next generation of model progress depends on real, proprietary data grounded in how actual businesses operate. We are a primary source of it, partnering directly with the frontier AI labs building what comes next.
### Why Join Sunset Now
  * We have scaled from $0 to a multi-eight-figure run rate in a matter of months
  * We have raised from top-tier investors, including Floodgate, Afore, Ludlow, and Hustle Fund
  * We are small enough that you will carry outsized responsibility and grow as quickly as the company does
  * You will partner with and build for some of the fastest and most important companies in the world
  * You will help build a massive, category-defining business from the ground floor


### The Role
We're hiring a backend engineer to make the pipeline that de-identifies sensitive enterprise data correct, replayable, operable, and safe to change.
This is not a conventional data-platform role where a successful job is enough. A pipeline can finish while silently dropping records, duplicating output, applying stale policy, losing lineage, or producing evidence that cannot establish whether a dataset is safe to release. You will own the backend systems and contracts that make those failure modes visible, preventable, and recoverable.
You will work across asynchronous orchestration, batch workers, queues, object storage, databases, many file formats, model-backed stages, deterministic verification, and human review. The role is backend-focused, but the outcome is a product and delivery promise: the team must know what ran, what changed, what remains uncertain, and what can safely happen next.
### What You'll Own
  * Design and ship backend systems for multi-stage, high-volume data processing
  * Define authoritative, versioned contracts for manifests, artifacts, lineage, and state transitions
  * Make retries, checkpoints, partial failures, replay, backfills, migrations, and rollbacks safe and understandable
  * Build independent reconciliation and verification instead of treating job success as proof of correct output
  * Turn escaped and recurring failures into fixtures, regression coverage, release gates, and durable recovery paths
  * Expose trustworthy run state and safe controls to the products people use to investigate and release data
  * Diagnose production behavior across code, queues, stores, artifacts, data formats, and deployed versions
  * Improve correctness, throughput, and operating leverage without weakening privacy, security, or release confidence
  * Use AI deeply in development and in bounded verification systems, with explicit evaluation and independent checks
  * Partner with machine learning, applied science, full-stack product, platform, security, and data engineering teammates


### What Success Looks Like
  * A high-risk pipeline boundary has an explicit contract, independent reconciliation, replayable coverage, and safe recovery
  * Missing, duplicated, stale, or incompatible work is detected before it becomes a customer delivery
  * Material pipeline state and release decisions are backed by queryable provenance and audit evidence
  * Recurring reruns, manual interventions, and diagnosis or recovery time decline
  * Adjacent engineers can add stages and checks through supported patterns instead of one-off scripts and implicit storage conventions
  * Pipeline changes can be rolled out, backfilled, quarantined, or reversed without delivery heroics


### You Might Thrive Here If
  * You have at least three years of professional software engineering experience, including personal ownership of production backend systems
  * You are strong in asynchronous or distributed systems and can reason precisely about queues, concurrency, state, storage, idempotency, partial failure, and recovery
  * You have worked on systems where output could be materially wrong even when every service looked healthy
  * You define invariants and use reconciliation, control totals, diffs, replay, goldens, shadow paths, or independent sources to verify correctness
  * You can design versioned data and artifact contracts and migrate them safely in a live system
  * You debug from evidence across system

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer IoT & Connectivity (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Willkommen bei Wirelane

Deutschland verzeichnet neue Rekordzulassungszahlen von Elektrofahrzeugen sowie eine rasant steigende Zahl von Lademöglichkeiten. Die Bundesregierung hat sich in diesem Kontext sehr ambitionierte Ziele gesetzt und möchte bis zum Jahr 2030 15 Millionen zugelassene elektrische Fahrzeuge und 1 Million installierte öffentliche Ladepunkte erreichen.
Als Full Service Provider für Ladeinfrastruktur bewegt sich Wirelane somit in einem sehr dynamischen und stark wachsenden Marktumfeld. Dabei müssen wir die stetig steigende Nachfrage nach und Anforderungen an innovativen Ladelösungen für Elektrofahrzeuge beherrschen.
Für unser schnell wachsendes Team suchen wir Dich als Embedded Software Engineer IoT & Connectivity (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams "Build It" an unserem Firmenhauptsitz in München.
In dieser Rolle sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Ladeinfrastruktur zuverlässig vernetzt bleibt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Embedded Software, IoT Connectivity und Payment-Systemen und trägst maßgeblich zur Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung unserer technischen Plattform bei.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreust unsere Embedded Software für Router, Connectivity-Lösungen und Payment Terminals.
  • Du verantwortest Firmware Updates und Rollouts für unsere installierte Geräteflotte.
  • Du stellst die zuverlässige Kommunikation zwischen Ladestation, Router und Bezahlsystem sicher. 
  • Du analysierst und behebst technische Störungen in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Mobilfunk und VPN. 
  • Du entwickelst Lösungen für Monitoring, Fernwartung und Automatisierung unserer Geräte.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Hardware-, Software- und Operations-Teams an der Weiterentwicklun unserer Ladeinfrastruktur zusammen.


Wen wir suchen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Embedded Systems, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Embedded Softwareentwicklung
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie C oder C++
  • Erfahrung mit Embedded-Systemen und hardwarenaher Softwareentwicklung
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich IoT, Cloud-Technologien und vernetzter Geräte
  • Erfahrung mit Firmware-Management und Geräteflotten von Vorteil
  • Gute Kenntnisse von Netzwerkprotokollen wie TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP oder HTTPS
  • Erfahrung mit VPN-Technologien wie WireGuard, OpenVPN oder IPsec
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich LTE- und 5G-Kommunikation sind von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Warum Wirelane?

  • Du übernimmst spannende Aufgaben in einem Technologieunternehmen mit einem innovativen und breiten Produktangebot.   
  • Du profitierst von einem attraktiven Gesamtpaket aus Vergütung, Mitarbeiter-Benefits und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Du bist Teil einer rasant wachsenden Industrie, die zum ökologischen, gesellschaftlichen und wirtschaftlichen Wandel beiträgt.   
  • Du arbeitest im motivierenden Arbeitsumfeld eines zielorientierten und schnell wachsendem Startups, das Du mitgestaltest.   
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung und arbeitest selbstständig in einem dynamischen Team.   
  • Du arbeitest auf  Augenhöhe mit kurzen Kommunikationswegen, offenen Türen und mit engagierten Kolleg*innen mit viel Teamgeist und großer Umsetzungsstärke.


Wer ist Wirelane?

Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von starken Werten. Diese leiten uns in unserem Handeln und in unserer Zusammenarbeit:

 Candour - We believe that open beats closed. 
 Collaboration - We are better together.
 Competence - We want to better our best.
 Courage - We question the status quo.
 Circularity - We care about what comes next.
  
Jede:r neue Mitarbeiter:in bietet uns die Möglichkeit, eine andere Perspektive einzubringen. Unser Ziel ist es, ein vielfältiges Team aufzubauen in der Alle, auch über das operative Geschäft hinaus, ihren Beitrag leisten und sich entwicklen können.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are on the hunt for
 **AI/ML Engineer** 
 who harbors a deep\-seated passion for artificial intelligence. Do you love solving problems with a unique blend of creative flair and meticulous attention to detail? You'll be a critical contributor to the creation of cutting\-edge AI models, honing their performance to perfection and masterfully translating complex theoretical constructs into robust, production\-caliber innovations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Help craft, refine, troubleshoot, and deploy sophisticated predictive models, deep learning algorithms, and machine learning frameworks.
* Unravel the intricate workings of ML algorithms, including their structures and features, identify root causes of any pesky bugs and design intelligent solutions.
* Delve into the depths of data to distill root issues, prepare detailed reports, and detect recurring problem patterns through insightful analysis.
* Design and develop large language model (LLM) use cases, ensuring they are equipped with appropriate guardrails and leverage advanced LLM Operations techniques to guarantee a high\-quality output upon productionization.
* Train and retrain systems as needed, incorporating adaptability and foresight into the continuous improvement process.
* Conduct thorough literature reviews to stay at the forefront of the latest developments in the specified research areas.
* Analyze and interpret research findings and use the learnings to design and build AI models and algorithms.
* Engage proactively in regular team meetings to share progress, address challenges, and brainstorm potential improvements.
